n269cb03253.headline: Unrest and Violence Spread to Egypt's Stock Exchange
n269cb03253.summary: The Cairo stock exchange was suspended following a drop in the leading index amid demonstrations and unrest.
n269cb03253.why: Political unrest can disrupt financial markets and investor confidence, affecting capital flows and economic stability.
n269cb03253.why_moved: The suspension and index drop reflect investor reaction to political instability in Egypt.
